episode_summary: In this episode, Brenton Miebach shares how he leverages AI and paid leads to rapidly establish a successful real estate business in new markets. He discusses the development of AI-driven systems to automate operations, enhance client service, and grow a social media presence. Brenton's insights provide actionable strategies for agents looking to scale their business and improve efficiency.
